registration.reference_depth_source: NOAA lidar corrected from NAVD88 to MLLW plus independently observed acquisition-time gauge level; no SDB or blending
registration.offshore_depth_source: ETOPO2022 EGM2008 elevation used only to screen >100m water; never used as reporting depth
registration.sensitivity_interpretation: Prespecified perturbation scenarios, not confidence intervals.
registration.evaluation: Fit attenuation on fixed buffered 500m calibration blocks; assess depth-bin quantile residuals on opposite blocks. Report both terrain classes without habitat names; forward/inverse closure is algebra only.
limitations: Offshore and shallow lagoon water may differ; report sensitivity to both fixed patches.
ETOPO is coarser and has a different datum; its values enter offshore screening only.
Gauge spatial representativeness unmeasured; +/-0.25m depth scenarios are not confidence intervals.
Coastal terrain is not observed substrate ground truth.
Fresh larger ACOLITE processing extent can change aerosol estimation relative to the SDB experiment.

tide.caveat: A single Key West gauge does not resolve water-level gradients along the strip.
